spans.s:
The affix क्वनिप्‌ comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' in the sense of past time, when in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.

Terms: क्वनिप्‌

The words 1. दृशे 2. विख्ये are anomalous Vedic Infinitives.

Terms: Irregular

comes after a word in construction in the Instrumental -3rd case, in the sense of seen - the thing seen by the one whose name is in the Instrumental -3rd case, being the साम वेद।

Terms: अण्
